behaviors.description: Under the committed strict policy the grader accepts the answer it is asked to grade.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The grade answer reports ok and the verdict accepted.

directions.text: The grade answer endpoint (with the supplied query answer): its ok field and its verdict field is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The response body of the grade request. A result that does not report ok, or whose verdict is not accepted is treated as a defect.

safetyLimits: The grader listens on loopback only and makes no network call.
